answer: An attacker flooding fake identities hits the nadir of the token supply fast, since each mint costs real value and duplicates are rejected, making mass sybil creation economically ruinous. Sybil resistance via pigment-staked reputation slot: each agent must burn a unique on-chain pigment token to mint its identity, and that token's scarcity is enforced by a beacon contract that rotates issuance epochs. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
